clause: studio_* design-system authority tables + dated migrations [STU-DS-049,STU-CON-004]

scope.summary: Author the design-system studio_* tables as dated migrations (YYYY_MM_DD_studio_*.sql + .down.sql) with TEXT PRIMARY KEY prefixed ids and event_ledger_event_id NOT NULL FK: studio_components (SCMP-), studio_component_instances (SCIN-), studio_variables (SVAR-), studio_variable_collections (SVCL-), studio_styles (SSTY-). StudioAutoLayout/StudioConstraint/StudioLayoutGrid persist as typed fields on the owning studio_layers row (MT-004), not new tables. guard_authority_write(Postgres) on every write; no SQLite.
acceptance_criteria: design-system tables migrate on managed Postgres; layout primitives as layer fields; no SQLite; write-guard proven
proof_targets: live PostgreSQL migration up/down + write-guard test
expected_tests: test: no_sqlite_tripwire fires on any design-system authority write without Postgres
test: prefixed-id + event_ledger_event_id FK enforced on all five tables

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No durable design-system authority store; components/variables/styles cannot promote.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
